transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

It’s… mostly bridges. If I know I have to cross one, before I’m even on it my heart starts pounding, my hands get damp on the steering wheel, and I get this rush of fear. It’s gotten hard to deal with.
Can you tell me more about the fear you feel when crossing bridges? Does it happen with all bridges, or certain types, and do you find yourself avoiding them if possible?

Yes… I do avoid them, if I can. It’s been going on more than two years now. I plan errands and visits around routes that don’t use bridges.

Some are worse than others, but really if I know there’s a bridge involved, I start trying to get out of it. I’ve stopped going to San Juan, and I don’t do Seattle theater nights anymore.

If I absolutely have to cross one, I have to study the route ahead of time, pick the right time, and have someone with me. Even then I’m just… frightened the whole way across.
